description: GPS-free localisation benchmark. Every run gets ONLY the video, the `city` string and `vo_segment`; ground truth is used for offline scoring only (scripts/benchmark.py aggregate). Core and overlay fleets are reported separately and never pooled.

gt_source.hand-labelled: GPS fixes typed in by a person from map look-ups of the video
gt_source.kitti_oxts: KITTI raw OXTS RT3003 GPS/IMU (INS) global pose
gt_source.consumer_gps: consumer GPS receiver @1 Hz (no IMU fusion)
gt_source.applanix: Applanix POS LV post-processed GNSS/INS poses
gt_source.overlay_ocr: OCR of the GPS stamp burned into the video frame (not hand-verified)

window_source.full: the whole recording / dataset extract as distributed
window_source.prefix: the first N seconds of a longer video; N is where the hand labels end
window_source.operator_selected: a sub-sequence of a longer recording picked by an operator who had the GT track available; treat as potentially GT-informed
window_source.gt_continuous: window boundaries cut FROM the GT track (longest cut-free run of OCR'd GPS fixes) -- GT-derived by construction

splits.dev: Every clip that existed before this benchmark: all were used to tune the pipeline, so dev numbers are optimistic by construction.
splits.test: Reserved for FRESH clips added after the method is frozen. Empty today. `run` skips split=test unless --split test is given explicitly.
